title: See everything standing inside Hukam
summary: Bodies, souls, status, pain, blessing, and wandering all stand inside Hukam. Let that wideness leave ego with less to say.
takeaway: Let the wideness of Hukam leave ego with less to say.
lifeApplication: When resistance rises, name one part of this moment you did not author and let humility answer before complaint does.

source.shortMeaning: Everything stands within Hukam, and understanding this leaves ego with less to say.
source.lifeApplication: Name what is already inside Hukam before the ego begins its complaint.

evidence.coreClaim: Everything stands within Hukam, and understanding this leaves ego with less to say.
evidence.turn: The pauree widens reality until no condition remains outside Command and self-importance has no clean place to stand.
evidence.practicalImplication: When resistance rises, name one part of this moment you did not author and let humility answer before complaint does.
